ligatures.pdf.purpose: Text with fi/fl/ff/ffi/ffl ligature glyphs (one glyph for several characters) to test selection offsets and copy.
ligatures.pdf.ligatureGlyphs: Each of fi, fl, ff, ffi, ffl is drawn as one glyph (Crimson Text liga feature). The ToUnicode CMap maps each ligature glyph to its component letters, so pdf.js extracts plain "fi", "ffi", etc. (not U+FB01..U+FB04).
